text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I can tell already... I can't win... I'll 
never catch up to her—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“—Still...! Until the very last step... I 
won't! I will never give up...!!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And the one who claimed the final crown 
of the Tiara route is!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: It's Gentildonnaaaa!!
(Waaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even putting everything on the line... gh, 
I still can't reach...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: To her... I am...—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations. You truly are... very 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes, that sounds about right.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: And, you as well.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You pressed me so closely. Your 
tenacity... sent shivers down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think the others might be 
feeling the same way?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis! Big sis...!! You were so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Big sis...! Great job out there...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fans A & B
text_block_list.text:
That got me so crazy hyped~~!! Thank you 
so much too, Verxina~~!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You gave me quite the challenge; I was 
thoroughly entertained.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Having lost, I really hate to say this. 
Saying something like this... but still.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.

Verxina firmly grasped the hand offered by 
Gentildonna... As the two rivals showed 
mutual respect, the crowd erupted into the 
loudest cheer of the day.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ugh......! Aaaahhhhh......!!

As she collapsed and wept aloud without 
caring about her surroundings... all I 
could do was gently stroke her back in 
comfort and appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Phew...

After having a good cry, Verxina remained 
sitting on the ground for quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I feel a little calmer now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, for showing you such a pathetic 
side of me...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...And on top of that, to end up unable 
to stand..."
choice_data_list:
It was a fierce race, so of course you're 
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: It seems so. However...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I feel refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
My path is one and only. I shall prove my 
strength on the Tiara route— and reach the 
next pinnacle!

In the Senior Class ahead, there are races 
with many Tiara route Umamusume competing, 
like the Victoria Mile and Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup.

Eventually, Verxina will also set her 
sights on those races. And on that path, 
surely—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
And as for Gentil-san, this time... I will 
show her a complete victory.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"With the heart of the strong, I shall 
claim victory... and become truly worthy 
of being called a queen!"

From the way she stood with a confident 
smile, glimpses of that potential were 
already plain to see—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, that settles it. Let us proceed 
as planned.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: A path of supremacy... befitting of me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Is Ms. Gentile's next target... the Japan 
Cup?
choice_data_list: Yeah, there was an announcement just now.

text_block_list.text:
It seems the plans for Gentildonna's next 
race were announced during a post-race 
interview... It came in as breaking news.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup... Tokyo Racecourse, 2,400 
meters.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
A race where the nation's finest gather. 
Indeed, it seems right up their alley, 
but...

There was a reason for her hesitation. 
Many Umamusume following the Tiara route 
had challenged this same race before, but—

—Historically, no one has ever won during 
their "Classic Class" year yet.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Having to compete against Senior-class 
Umamusume with such a difference in 
experience is also tough.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Moreover... the Japan Cup has an 
atmosphere quite distinct from the Tiara 
series.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ms. Gentile's target is—
choice_data_list:
Aiming for the pinnacle of everything, are 
we?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, then I, too, shall 
head for the Japan Cup..."

Verxina's fatigue is considerable. I don't 
think two months will be enough to get her 
fully back in shape. In the worst-case 
scenario, she could even wreck her body...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. You're right, aren't you...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This won't do. When it comes to the summit 
she is aiming for... I just find myself 
wanting to chase after it.
choice_data_list:
Then do you want to aim for the next 
summit?

Then will you try aiming for the next 
summit?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: The next pinnacle... By that, you mean...
choice_data_list:
First, what do you think about the Osaka 
Hai?
First, how about the Osaka Hai?

text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai is a 2000m GⅠ race held in 
the spring. Using this race, where 
talented Umamusume gather, as a starting 
point—

She will continue to take on GⅠ races 
after this, conquering summits distinct 
from those of Gentildonna.
choice_data_list:
It might be a bit of a distant goal, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...So this judgment was made after 
assessing my condition, correct?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the proposal.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
After conquering the Osaka Hai, let us 
claim all the pride of the Tiara line!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"So... there is something I would like to 
consult you about."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Please let me go watch the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...It's embarrassing to admit, but I 
haven't had the leeway until now... and I 
don't think I was looking at her 
objectively."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If we watch her run from the outside... 
the reason behind that overwhelming 
strength should become crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of the future. I want to 
understand her... and come up with a 
countermeasure."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Um, Sis...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh? ...Did Vivlos fall asleep?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It was pure chaos the whole time, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...What's up? Did you get hungry?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-No...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...May I... come along too, for the 
'Japan Cup'?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: S-Sorry, um... I overheard that.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-Yeah, I'm just in the way, aren't I? 
If I'm here..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ! No, of course I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go together! Big sis will make us a 
boxed lunch."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-It's okay! You really don't have to go 
that far...

And so, with our sights still set on the 
Osaka Hai, we decided to go spectate the 
Japan Cup.
